L1_venous_boundary_deployment.M6_eShunt: Endovascular percutaneous transvenous-transdural deployment in dural venous sinus
L1_venous_boundary_deployment.El_Shafei: Surgical ventriculojugular/ventriculosinus — NOT endovascular, requires craniotomy/surgical access
L1_venous_boundary_deployment.Sinushunt: Surgical deployment in venous sinus — NOT endovascular
L1_venous_boundary_deployment.1975_venous: Surgical ventriculo-venous to occluded neck vein — NOT endovascular
L1_venous_boundary_deployment.M6_differentiated: YES — endovascular deployment is architecturally distinct from all historical surgical approaches

L2_anti_reflux_mechanism.M6_eShunt: Active backflow prevention with 99% reduction (mechanical one-way valve + active control)
L2_anti_reflux_mechanism.El_Shafei: Retrograde flow design — CSF flows AGAINST blood flow direction to create impact zone that prevents stagnation
L2_anti_reflux_mechanism.Sinushunt: Sinus-pressure-dependent resistance — passive anti-reflux via pressure differentials
L2_anti_reflux_mechanism.1975_venous: CSF flow washing blood away from catheter tip — passive flow-based anti-stagnation
L2_anti_reflux_mechanism.M6_differentiated: PARTIAL — active valve is different from passive flow-direction/pressure mechanisms, but the CONCEPT of anti-reflux at venous boundary is NOT new

L3_anti_thrombus_mechanism.M6_eShunt: Dual-zone coating: anti-fouling on CSF side + anti-thrombogenic (heparin-eluting) on venous side
L3_anti_thrombus_mechanism.El_Shafei: Impact zone design — CSF impacts blood flow to prevent stagnation/clotting (flow-based, not coating)
L3_anti_thrombus_mechanism.Sinushunt: No explicit anti-thrombus coating — relies on pressure differentials
L3_anti_thrombus_mechanism.1975_venous: CSF flow prevents clotting around catheter end (flow-based, not coating)
L3_anti_thrombus_mechanism.M6_differentiated: YES — dual-zone coating is architecturally different from flow-based anti-thrombus. BUT: the CONCEPT of preventing thrombus at venous interface is NOT new

L4_anti_fouling_surface.M6_eShunt: Anti-fouling surface coating on CSF-side lumen (resists protein/cell adhesion)
L4_anti_fouling_surface.El_Shafei: No anti-fouling coating — relies on flow dynamics, not surface treatment
L4_anti_fouling_surface.1975_venous: No anti-fouling coating — relies on flow
L4_anti_fouling_surface.M6_differentiated: YES — surface coating is NOT taught by historical venous shunts. This is a modern addition.

L5_combined_anti_fouling_plus_anti_reflu.M6_eShunt: Combined: anti-fouling surface + active backflow prevention + anti-thrombogenic zone
L5_combined_anti_fouling_plus_anti_reflu.El_Shafei: Flow-based anti-reflux + anti-stagnation (no coating, no active valve)
L5_combined_anti_fouling_plus_anti_reflu.Sinushunt: Pressure-based anti-reflux (no coating, no active valve)
L5_combined_anti_fouling_plus_anti_reflu.M6_differentiated: YES — the COMBINATION of surface coating + active valve + dual-zone is NOT taught by any historical architecture. BUT: each component individually exists in some form.

L6_biological_turnover_awareness.M6_eShunt: Designed to work WITH biological clearance (thrombus lysis, endothelialization, flow clearance)
L6_biological_turnover_awareness.El_Shafei: Designed to PREVENT stagnation via flow — implicitly relies on biological clearance but doesn't model it
L6_biological_turnover_awareness.1975_venous: Relies on CSF flow to maintain patency — implicitly biological
L6_biological_turnover_awareness.M6_differentiated: NO — biological turnover is a model feature, not an architectural differentiator. Historical shunts also implicitly rely on biological clearance.

part_2_summary.key_differentiation: endovascular deployment (L1) + dual-zone coating (L3) + combined approach (L5)
part_2_summary.key_weakness: anti-reflux concept NOT new (L2) + biological turnover not architectural (L6)

part_3_continuous_continuum.biological_plausibility: NEEDS EVIDENCE — must validate clearance parameters against literature

verdict.historical_prior_art_threat: HIGH — El-Shafei teaches anti-reflux + anti-stagnation at venous boundary
verdict.real_invention_may_be: venous-interface architecture (combined coating + valve + flow topology), not 'better coating'
verdict.patent_status: SEARCH_INCOMPLETE — historical venous-shunt prior art requires claim-level audit
